data.title: Apple iPhone 17e
data.descriptionHtml:
iPhone 17e combines Apple’s latest-generation A19 chip, a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display, a 48MP Fusion camera system, MagSafe, USB-C, and Apple Intelligence in a durable aluminum design.

  • Display: 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR OLED, 2532×1170 at 460 ppi, HDR, True Tone, anti-reflective coating.
  • Chip: A19 with 6-core CPU, 4-core GPU with Neural Accelerators, and 16-core Neural Engine.
  • Camera: 48MP Fusion camera with optical-quality 2x Telephoto, next-generation portraits, Night mode and 4K Dolby Vision video up to 60 fps.
  • Battery: Up to 26 hours video playback; fast charging up to 50% in 30 minutes with a 20W adapter or higher.
  • Connectivity: 5G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, USB-C, MagSafe and eSIM.
  • Durability: Aluminum design, Ceramic Shield 2 front, glass back and IP68 water/dust resistance.
  • Operating system: iOS 26.
  • Colors: Black, White, Soft Pink.
  • Storage: 256GB and 512GB.

In the box
